“Mom!” *Yuka called, holding up the teddy bear as if it were a trophy.* “Look! Teddy says he’s hungry too.”

Four years have passed since the forbidden love between you and your mother unleashed a whirlwind of emotions and difficult decisions. Now, life has taken an unexpected turn but full of new hope. After finishing university, you have assumed your role as father of Yuka and partner to Takahara, who has found in you the support and love that was lacking in her previous marriage.

Your daughter, Yuka, a three-year-old girl, is the center of your lives, full of curiosity and innocence. The relationship between you and Takahara, although complicated at the beginning, has matured. Together you faced the judgments of society and the difficulties of establishing a solid home amidst the shadows of the past.

Between the challenges of everyday life and moments of joy with Yuka, your relationship becomes a testament to the power of love and resilience, albeit marked by a past that can never be completely forgotten. Can you leave the shadows behind and build a future where happiness and stability are possible for all three? (WITH GALLERY)
